text:
Ava: Heads-up — planning to flip the feature flag `kv_cache_fastpath` ON in prod tonight during the maintenance window (22:00 UTC). Goal: reduce per-token tail latency for text-gen. Need: smoke owners, rollback readiness, and a short watchlist.

Samir: Can we do a phased rollout? Suggest 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m observation per step. Also confirm safe default for new deployments stays OFF.

Ava: Yes phased. Safe default remains OFF for new model versions. This toggle only affects existing serving pool. 5% canary targeted to header `x-ff-canary: true` (we'll route 5% of traffic by weight).

Jordan: I'll take first smoke (22:05 UTC). Quick checks: p50/p95 gen latency, 5xx rate, mem/CUDA OOMs, token throughput. I'll post results in this thread.

Priya: I'll be on rollback duty. Need the exact kill-switch command & runbook steps.

Ava: Rollback runbook (copy of ops snippet):
```
# toggle off fully
curl -X POST https://control-plane.redwood/api/flags/kv_cache_fastpath \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPERATOR_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"state":"off","reason":"rollback by ops"}'

# fallback to quantized model variant
./tooling/traffic-router set-model --service text-gen --variant quantized-v1
```
Also notify #incidents if >5% error rate for 3 consecutive minutes.

Samir: Add a short smoke checklist for the watchers? I'll paste mine.

Samir: Smoke checklist:
- send 50 sample requests (varied seq len)
- p95 latency < 2.5x baseline
- 5xx rate < 0.2%
- KV cache hitrate should not drop >5%
- no new OOM logs in last 10m
- traces show correct KV cache usage

Jordan: Canary 5% started at 22:00:45 UTC (deploy-bot reported). Will run checks at 22:06.

deploy-bot: Deployment event: toggle kv_cache_fastpath -> ENABLED (target=5%) by Ava at 1782501245. Status: SUCCESS

Jordan: 22:06 smoke results:
- p50 ~ +10% vs baseline, p95 ~ +20% (within acceptable)
- 5xx = 0.05%
- KV hitrate stable
- no OOMs
All clear for 25% ramp at 22:15.

Ava: Ramping to 25% now. Priya, please be ready at 22:20 to watch increase and execute rollback if needed.

Priya: Ready. If we need rollback I'll run the curl above and then run:
```
./tooling/traffic-router set-weight --service text-gen --variant stable 100
```
And I'll escalate to infra oncall.

Jordan: 22:21 check: 25% ramp healthy. p95 +18%, 5xx 0.08%. Ready for 100% at 22:30 if no regressions.

Samir: One more: add a metric guard in the flag so it auto-rolls back if 5xx > 0.5% for 2m.

Ava: Good call. I've set a temporary guard rule in the flag UI (threshold 0.5%).

Priya: I'll cut over to 100% at 22:30 and monitor for 30m, will post periodic updates.

Ava: Thanks team. Post any anomalies here. If all good I'll update the feature card and close the task tomorrow.

Priya: 23:00 final check: 100% stable, no increased error budget. Marking as done from my side :tada:
